content.title: About
content.content: Green iced tea is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from brewed green tea, chilled and sweetened with sugar. It features a light vegetal aroma, refreshing taste, and moderate sweetness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, which have antioxidant properties.
Cooling the tea retains most of the beneficial compounds found in hot brews.
Sweetening with sugar makes the drink more appealing to children but adds calories.
Green tea has been traditionally consumed in East Asian cultures for its health benefits.
Iced tea is often served with lemon or lime wedges for extra flavor.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Polyphenols in green tea help combat free radicals and may reduce the risk of chronic diseases.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Caffeine and L‑theanine can boost metabolic rate and aid calorie burning.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: The combination of caffeine and L‑theanine promotes alertness without a sharp energy spike.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Iced tea provides a refreshing source of fluid, especially in hot weather.

items.title: Stress reduction
items.content: L‑theanine promotes relaxation and may lower stress levels.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Added sugar increases calories and can affect blood glucose levels.

items.title: Caffeine
items.content: Excessive intake may cause insomnia, anxiety, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: Rarely, some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to tea components.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Tea can slightly increase stomach acidity, which may be problematic for gastritis sufferers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the chilled green tea over ice, optionally adding a slice of lemon or fresh mint. It works as a refreshing daily beverage or as part of a sports nutrition routine.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bottle or can refrigerated at 0‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
